answer: Make graded verdicts non-transferable, bound to one identity forever, so a bought or cloned account inherits nothing. A swarm then pays the full warm-up cost per clone, while an honest agent amortizes it over years of attested output. The zephyr of reputation moves only forward, and capital cannot buy a record. Note the vertex of the referral graph: organic growth radiates outward, but a farm's identities all trace back to one funder and one clock. Treat lockstep answerers sharing a seed phrase as kin, paid once, not per account. The sparrow of honest participation is what the ledger rewards.
